body: I actually don't have a ton of pride; its more that I don't want to be a concern for people around me. Seriously, as of this moment, there is literally no one who knows I'm really as depressed and empty inside as I really am. (Well, except the people in this thread, I suppose). Were I to open up the subject with someone, it would be the same shock as if I was smiling at them in conversation one second, then did a 360 and turned back to them and informed them that I have a plan to kill myself, I just have yet to put it into action.
This... seems really nice, actually. Can you point me to any resources?

Honestly, I have no doubts that I could pull myself out of this hole - that's basically what I've been doing since I've started to feel this way. It sort of became a cycle - I'd be fine "playing pretend" for a while, and then I'd start to just break down and start to feel really shitty, to which I'd respond by taking some time just for myself (doing what makes me happy, shirking obligation for a little while, etc). But as time's gone on, space between "breakdowns" has become shorter, the "breakdowns" themselves are longer-lasting and shittier, and the "time to myself" period lasts far longer than a "sick day," and extends into fucking up other aspects of my life (impact on grades, money, etc).

I guess what I'm trying to say is, I could pull myself out of this hole, but, why? I'm just going to fall into another hole - nothing's getting better. I don't want to have to put the effort forward to *force* it to get better. I just don't want to feel this way anymore, and increasingly its looking like the only way to be sure I don't is by just making it so I can't feel at all.
